statement: Supplemental Lemma G.2 small-angle pair branch
source_correspondence: Actual moment averaging supplies4K(1−|ρ|), shifted positive weight derivative supplies28Δ²/h² exp(5R/h), actual G2 mass supplies64 exp1 π³h²/ν, and angle cancellation yields ν. Direction, scalar and displacement bounds are jointly almost-sure under the actual base/copy product; no target mass or remainder bound is assumed. The ordered-pair Hessian prefactor1/h² is included; source unordered-pair factor2 is obtained by doubling the universal constant.

∀ {Ξ : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ξ] {N p r : ℕ} (κ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ) (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p)
  (S : Finset (RectangleCLT.Face p)),
  S.card ≤ 2 →
    ∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (Z W : Fin N → Ξ → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (Z i)) →
        (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (W i)) →
          (∀ (i : Fin N) (j k : Fin r), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ => Z i ξ j * Z i ξ k) κ) →
            (∀ (i : Fin N) (j k : Fin r), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ => W i ξ j * W i ξ k) κ) →
              ∀ (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
                  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq v = 1 →
                    |u ⬝ᵥ v| < 1 →
                      ∀ (c : Fin N → Ξ → ℝ),
                        (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (c i)) →
                          ∀ (D d : Fin N → Ξ → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
                            (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (D i)) →
                              (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (d i)) →
                                ∀ {b K Δ R : ℝ},
                                  0 ≤ b →
                                    0 ≤ K →
                                      0 ≤ Δ →
                                        0 ≤ R →
                                          (∀ (i : Fin N), ∀ᵐ (ξ : Ξ) ∂κ, |c i ξ| ≤ b) →
                                            (∀ (i : Fin N), ∀ᵐ (ξ : Ξ) ∂κ, ‖D i ξ‖ ≤ Δ) →
                                              (∀ (i : Fin N), ∀ᵐ (ξ : Ξ) ∂κ, ‖d i ξ‖ ≤ R) →
                                                (∀ (e : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                                    ∑ i, ∫ (ξ : Ξ), RectangleCLT.faceDot e (Z i ξ) ^ 2 ∂κ ≤
                                                      K * RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq e) →
                                                  (∀ (e : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                                      ∑ i, ∫ (ξ : Ξ), RectangleCLT.faceDot e (W i ξ) ^ 2 ∂κ ≤
                                                        K * RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq e) →
                                                    (∀ (i : Fin N),
                                                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                          (fun ξ =>
                                                            c i ξ *
                                                                RectangleCLTArxivV1.capPairCoefficient u v (Z i ξ)
                                                                  (W i ξ) *
                                                              RectangleCLTArxivV1.capSoftFaceSecond s S (D i ξ)
                                                                (x + d i ξ))
                                                          κ) ∧
                                                      ∑ i,
                                                          ∫ (ξ : Ξ),
                                                            |c i ξ *
                                                                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.capPairCoefficient u v (Z i ξ)
                                                                    (W i ξ) *
                                                                RectangleCLTArxivV1.capSoftFaceSecond s S (D i ξ)
                                                                  (x + d i ξ)| ∂κ ≤
                                                        112 * b * K * Δ ^ 2 / s.bandwidth ^ 2 *
                                                              Real.exp (5 * R / s.bandwidth) *
                                                            (1 - |u ⬝ᵥ v|) *
                                                          s.softFaceWeight S x

    ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin q) ℝ) (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p),
      2 * δ ≤ s.bandwidth →
        ∀ (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p),
          f ≠ g →
            ∀ (Y : Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector q → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
              Measurable Y →
                ∀ (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
                    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq v = 1 →
                      |u ⬝ᵥ v| < 1 →
                        ∀ {v₀ : ℝ},
                          1 / 2 ≤ v₀ →
                            RectangleCLTArxivV1.capMixedCovariance μ X A = !![v₀, v₀ * u ⬝ᵥ v; v₀ * u ⬝ᵥ v, v₀] →
                              ∀ (a₀ a₁ : ℝ),
                                (∀ (z : Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector q),
                                    RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f (Y z) =
                                      RectangleCLTArxivV1.capMixedValue X A z 0 + a₀) →
                                  (∀ (z : Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector q),
                                      RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot g (Y z) =
                                        RectangleCLTArxivV1.capMixedValue X A z 1 + a₁) →
                                    ∀ (κ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ξ) [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.SFinite κ]
                                      (Z W : Fin N → Ξ → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                      (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (Z i)) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (W i)) →
                                          (∀ (i : Fin N) (j k : Fin r),
                                              MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ => Z i ξ j * Z i ξ k) κ) →
                                            (∀ (i : Fin N) (j k : Fin r),
                                                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ξ => W i ξ j * W i ξ k) κ) →
                                              ∀ (c : Fin N → (Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector q) × Ξ → ℝ),
                                                (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (c i)) →
                                                  ∀
                                                    (D d :
                                                      Fin N → (Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector q) × Ξ → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
                                                    (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (D i)) →
                                                      (∀ (i : Fin N), Measurable (d i)) →
                                                        ∀ {b K Δ R : ℝ},
                                                          0 ≤ b →
                                                            0 ≤ K →
                                                              0 ≤ Δ →
                                                                0 ≤ R →
                                                                  (∀ (i : Fin N),
                                                                      ∀ᵐ (z :
                                                                        (Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector q) ×
                                                                          Ξ) ∂(μ.prod
                                                                              (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian q)).prod
                                                                          κ,
                                                                        |c i z| ≤ b) →
                                                                    (∀ (i : Fin N),
                                                                        ∀ᵐ (z :
                                                                          (Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector q) ×
                                                                            Ξ) ∂(μ.prod
                                                                                (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian q)).prod
                                                                            κ,
                                                                          ‖D i z‖ ≤ Δ) →
                                                                      (∀ (i : Fin N),
                                                                          ∀ᵐ (z :
                                                                            (Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector q) ×
                                                                              Ξ) ∂(μ.prod
                                                                                  (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian
                                                                                    q)).prod
                                                                              κ,
                                                                            ‖d i z‖ ≤ R) →
                                                                        (∀ (e : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                                                            ∑ i,
                                                                                ∫ (ξ : Ξ),
                                                                                  RectangleCLT.faceDot e (Z i ξ) ^
                                                                                    2 ∂κ ≤
                                                                              K * RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq e) →
                                                                          (∀ (e : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                                                              ∑ i,
                                                                                  ∫ (ξ : Ξ),
                                                                                    RectangleCLT.faceDot e (W i ξ) ^
                                                                                      2 ∂κ ≤
                                                                                K * RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq e) →
                                                                            MeasureTheory.Integrable ⋯
                                                                                (μ.prod
                                                                                  (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian q)) ∧
                                                                              ⋯ ≤ ⋯
